title: Fractals in Jackson Pollock's paintings

plain: The seemingly chaotic drip paintings of the artist Jackson Pollock contain fractals, which are patterns that repeat at every scale. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels to go look it up, pointing him to a Scientific American article called "Order in Pollock's Chaos" by the physicist Richard P. Taylor. For Jorjani, it shows that hidden order can turn up where everything looks random.
